# Google Cloud Vision

Google Cloud Vision API enables developers to integrate vision detection features into applications, including image labeling, face and landmark detection, optical character recognition (OCR), and explicit content tagging.

Category: Other. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/google-cloud-vision/.

## Actions

- **Create ReferenceImage**: Create a ReferenceImage under a product.
- **Create Vision Product**: Create and return a new Product resource.
- **Delete Product**: Permanently delete a Product and its reference images.
- **Get Product** (read-only): Get information associated with a Product.
- **Get Product Set** (read-only): Get a ProductSet.
- **Get Reference Image** (read-only): Get information associated with a ReferenceImage.
- **Import Product Sets**: Asynchronously import reference images into ProductSets from a CSV in GCS.
- **List Locations** (read-only): List available Vision AI service locations for a project.
- **List Projects** (read-only): List Google Cloud projects accessible by the authenticated user.
- **List Reference Images** (read-only): List reference images for a product.
- **List Vision API Operations** (read-only): List operations that match the specified filter.
- **Purge Products**: Asynchronously delete products in a ProductSet or orphan products.
- **Update Product**: Update a Product's mutable fields.
- **Update Product Set**: Update a ProductSet resource.
- **Add Product to ProductSet**: Add a Product to a specified ProductSet.
- **Cancel Vision Operation**: Cancel a long-running Vision API operation.
- **Delete Product Set**: Permanently delete a ProductSet.
- **Delete Reference Image**: Permanently delete a reference image.
- **Delete Vision API Operation**: Delete a long-running Vision API operation.
- **Get Vision API Operation** (read-only): Get the latest state of a long-running operation.
- **List IndexEndpoints** (read-only): List IndexEndpoints in a project and location.
- **List Products in ProductSet** (read-only): List Products in a specified ProductSet.
- **Remove Product from ProductSet**: Remove a Product from a specified ProductSet.
